neutral.EN: I heard you.
I heard that little remark.
Caught that.
I heard what you whispered.
Message heard.
I hear where your head is at.
neutral.TL: Naririnig ko kung ano ang iniisip mo.

neutral.EN: Got that loud and clear.
I heard you just fine.
Heard you. Don't think I missed it.
neutral.TL: Narinig kita. Huwag mong isiping pinalampas ko.

neutral.EN: I caught that flirt.
You are bold, I will give you that.
You certainly don't lack nerve.
neutral.TL: Talagang hindi ka kulang sa lakas ng loob.

neutral.EN: Bold move talking like that out here.
neutral.TL: Matapang na hakbang ang magsalita nang ganyan dito.

neutral.EN: You have plenty of confidence, I'll say that.
neutral.TL: Marami kang tiwala sa sarili, aaminin ko.

neutral.EN: That's quite a forward thing to say.
You certainly know how to shoot your shot.
neutral.TL: Marunong ka talagang sumubok ng diskarte mo.

neutral.EN: Bold words for someone in danger.
neutral.TL: Matatapang na salita para sa taong nasa panganib.

neutral.EN: I admire the guts, if nothing else.
neutral.TL: Hanga ako sa tapang mo, kahit 'yon man lang.

neutral.EN: You're definitely not shy.
You like living dangerously, don't you?
neutral.TL: Gusto mo talagang sumugal sa delikado, 'no?
